p='submission/compiler.py';s=open(p).read()

s=s.replace('    Ts,Cs=_Gen(H,participants,roots).generate()','''    if generator == "fast":
        try:
            Ts, Cs = fast_generate(H, participants, roots)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise PlanFailure(('fast generator', exc))
    else:
        Ts, Cs = _Gen(H, participants, roots).generate()''')
# Replace compile_plan function fully
start=s.index('def compile_plan(')
new='''def compile_plan(n, links, participants, roots, p, env):
    """Return ('denied', cut_vertices) or ('prepared', plan).

    Raises PlanFailure only if an internally feasible instance could not be
    compiled; callers should never see this for a correctly formed instance.
    """
    cut = find_deficient_cut(n, links, participants, roots, p, env)
    if cut is not None:
        return ('denied', cut)
    switches = sorted(v for v in range(n) if v not in set(participants))
    orders = [switches]
    if len(switches) > 1:
        orders.append(list(reversed(switches)))
    last = None
    for order in orders:
        try:
            H, em = remove_switches(n, links, participants, roots, p, env,
                                    switch_order=order)
        except PlanFailure as exc:
            last = exc
            continue
        # The fast generator is normally sufficient.  The legacy-equivalent
        # generator is retained as an exact fallback for unusual orderings.
        for mode in ('fast', 'legacy'):
            try:
                plan = build_plan(H, em, participants, roots, n, links, p, env,
                                  generator=mode)
                return ('prepared', plan)
            except PlanFailure as exc:
                last = exc
    if last is None:
        last = PlanFailure('compilation failed')
    raise last
'''
s=s[:start]+new
open(p,'w').write(s)
